schema_completeness.detail: All 10 config keys (host, port, log_level, request_timeout, max_connections, debug_mode, static_dir, cors_origins, keep_alive_timeout, ssl_enabled) are defined with correct types, defaults, and env var mappings.

config_validation_error.detail: ConfigValidationError inherits from ValueError. All error messages include key name and invalid value.

validation_rules.detail: host: non-empty string; port: [2048,49151]; log_level: {'INFO','WARN','ERROR'} case-sensitive; request_timeout: [1,3600]; max_connections: [1,1000]; debug_mode: bool strings case-insensitive (true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off); static_dir: non-empty string; keep_alive_timeout: [1,300]; ssl_enabled: bool strings case-insensitive.

type_coercion.detail: int: int() with ConfigValidationError on failure. float: float() with ConfigValidationError on failure. bool: string true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off case-insensitive; Python bool checked before int (isinstance bool guard). enum: string membership check. string: str().

priority_cascade.detail: Correct order: defaults → config_file → env_vars → cli_args. Higher-priority sources override lower.

api_contract.detail: load_config(config_file, env_vars, cli_args) -> dict, get_schema() -> dict (deep copy), validate_value(key, value) -> object. All signatures match spec.

error_handling.detail: Validation failures → ConfigValidationError. FileNotFoundError re-raised as-is. Invalid JSON → ConfigValidationError.

edge_cases.detail: Empty env var ('') does not override. Unknown config file keys silently ignored. All schema keys always present in returned dict. bool isinstance(bool) checked before isinstance(int).

summary: All requirements from spec.md verified: 10 config keys, type coercion, validation rules, priority cascade, API contract, error handling, and edge cases all pass.
